representation: First K complex components from the frozen REST1_LR basis; Cartesian Re/Im coordinates
train: REST1_LR, all core frames stride4, soft HMM posterior targets
test: REST2_LR/RL, all core frames100:1100; frozen HMM-agreement mask
early_stopping: Patience4; continue when either all-validation MSE improves by >1e-5 or agreement-validation accuracy improves by >1e-4
selection_rules: Highest agreement-frame validation accuracy; ties use lower agreement-frame MSE
mask: HMM label permutation fixed using REST1_LR posterior correlations; agreement on validation and test computed without fitting alignment there
purpose: Test whether fewer components improve conditional accuracy; all ranks have a common encoding, HMM, architecture, optimizer grid and training budget
limits: Exploratory reuse of previously examined test acquisitions; same participants across scans; not unseen-family validation. Agreement is a target-derived retrospective subset. Effective active capacity changes with rank despite common padded architecture.
